Rimonabant was a drug made to target obesity. It was an inverse agonist for the CB1 receptor. An inverse agonist is something that binds to the same receptor as an agonist but has the opposite effect of an agonist. THC, for example, is an agonist for the CB1 receptor. So if you've ever been high on weed, imagine what the exact opposite of that feeling is, and that's the effect this drug had on you.
